name: Oone Kyouko
source: A teacher at the school [url=/c1383]Kenichi[/url] attends. She has a mild personality and is popular among her students, but can be harshly over-protective when it comes to her daughter, [url=/c191]Touka[/url]. She is hypersensitive to words with a "dog" connotation.
